execution: Four fresh-context reviewers; platform thread capacity required two waves. Every report was collected before triage. Verification-gap reviewer returned no gaps. Blind floor calculation N=min(floor(sqrt(1620.178)+1),10)=10; the arithmetic line is not a finding.

findings.claim: Optimizer/request-idle waits have no overall deadline, so a stalled optimizer could hang the bounded proxy smoke.
findings.evidence: Per-request deadlines exist; waitForRequestsIdle, scanProcessing and dependency.processing have no deadline. All actual Vite7/8/final runs settled. A reachable stalled optimizer plus non-exit reproduction is needed to establish the alleged hang; retain as medium unverified.

findings.claim: Clearing the callback after mounting hides setEditable mount/suspension callbacks.
findings.evidence: Confirmed core2.27.2 Editor.ts:192 and core3.32.0 Editor.ts:310 both default setEditable emitUpdate=true, and the application already called it before this change. Card Detail compares draft values with baseline; title-only rich-description regression passes. This callback behavior predates the upgrade.

findings.claim: Direct pasteHTML with a cast Event bypasses clipboard-data extraction and DOM paste dispatch.
findings.evidence: The test deliberately covers real ProseMirror parser/transaction/Markdown serialization, not clipboard extraction or OS paste. No changed local clipboard handler or observed failure was found. A real browser paste carrying HTML/plain text would settle the remaining medium unverified native-path risk.

findings.claim: Compatibility cases omit ordered/nested lists, blockquotes, code, strike and hard breaks.
findings.evidence: The focused corpus covers specified toolbar formats, prop sync, paste and unchanged-description Save; exact existing format regressions pass. No mismatch in the other formats was demonstrated. Compare an actual supported-format corpus between v2 and v3 to settle possible medium serialization risk.

findings.claim: Fetching transformed entry does not establish actual browser boot/render from the built application.
findings.evidence: Correct limit: proxy smoke proves HTTP transformation and proxy/native lifecycle; full mounted React suites and production static/deep-route/byte checks provide separate evidence. No native compiled-bundle boot was executed. A disposable native-browser boot/render exercise would settle a possible medium boot regression.

findings.claim: Unbounded optimizer waits could hang the smoke despite fetch deadlines.
findings.evidence: Same unverified root cause as E1; no stalled optimizer was reproduced in any actual run. Need a reachable stall and exit/cleanup observation before claiming the bad outcome.

findings.claim: Canonical proxy invocation records omit TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH required for exact replay.
findings.evidence: Parent reproduced ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND with recorded argv and passed with TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/server/tsconfig.json. Implementation agent confirmed this was the original inherited setting. Added explicit verified replay prerequisites to all seven proxy records/release record, retaining historical command/status/raw output.

findings.claim: Intermediate lock hashes without retained lockfiles cannot recreate every intermediate resolved graph.
findings.evidence: Historical graph replay is a real limitation, but ordinary development uses the final frozen lockfile. The accepted story requires intermediate exact versions/check results, which are retained; it explicitly withdrew per-upgrade commits. Recovering/retaining whole intermediate lock snapshots is more than a direct correction and rarely needed in everyday use. Do not claim intermediate clean-checkout reproducibility.

findings.claim: Tiptap tests predate adding the direct core dependency, so the completed runtime graph was not tested before static upgrade.
findings.evidence: The install log reports downloaded0/added0/Already up to date. Existing Tiptap core/pm/react/starter-kit were already3.32.0; adding the identical direct core peer link supports only the erased Storage type augmentation. Runtime modules did not change. Typecheck/build covered the declaration, and later full workspace/root checks additionally cover the final graph.

findings.claim: Manifest/privacy summaries omit newly added parent verification evidence.
findings.evidence: Confirmed original149-member manifest and privacy scope predated parent logs. Preserved original privacy summary, rescanned all current JSON/gzip/evidence and regenerated full member hashes; parent repeats integrity/privacy after final review evidence is added.

findings.claim: Instrumentation/index refer to a nonexistent vitest3-install-confirm.json; report alternates contradictory identical names.
findings.evidence: Exact retainedEvidence path exists on disk and in the manifest: vitest3-install-confirm.json. It parses, hashes correctly and records successful frozen install. No vitest3-install-confirmation.json is referenced by instrumentation or command index.

findings.claim: Strict preservation interpretation diverges at invalid overlong path JSON404→JSON403.
findings.evidence: This intentional upstream security refusal is explicitly recorded and exercised, with unchanged production web-app.ts, canonical200, noncanonical/case refusal and healthy API. The dependency story does not require bypassing updated security admission to preserve the status of an invalid path.

findings.claim: Native clipboard interaction is not established by JSDOM pasteHTML.
findings.evidence: Same verification limit as B2, explicitly admitted in acceptance-limits. No OS clipboard certification is claimed; a real browser/clipboard run is needed to settle any medium unverified incompatibility.

findings.claim: Mac automated checks do not establish native Windows/Linux or actual screen-reader acceptance.
findings.evidence: These checks were not executed and remain named operational prerequisites from prior epics/preparation, with platform/accessibility maintainer owners. They predate this story and cannot be inferred from green automated suites.

findings.claim: A completely clean audit interpretation exceeds zero high/critical plus one moderate.
findings.evidence: Story8.2 explicitly requires no critical/high and disclosure of unresolved advisories. High-threshold audit exits0, full JSON exits1, and development esbuild0.18.20 path/fix range/reason/owner are recorded without claiming a fully clean graph.

findings.claim: Handoff/acceptance records describe review/finalization as pending while parent verification is present.
findings.evidence: Those implementation-capture records correctly described pending review at their timestamps. This pass completes review and writes final state separately. Source checks, not a pending/done row, establish verification; no speculative commit/publication is implied.
